Name: T's Custom Slime Hutch Interior
Author: tikamin557
Description:
Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]ModConfig[/url] to customize it to your liking.

If "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9296]Esca's Modding Plugins (EMP)[/url]" are installed, the bed can be placed in the slime hatch for sleeping.

Currently, English (default) and Japanese translation files are included.
